The Simulation Center of Competence (CoC) at Polaris Bengaluru plays a critical role in driving virtual product development, ensuring that Polaris vehicles meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, safety, and refinement. As part of the Durability Team, you will be responsible for simulating real-world usage scenarios to evaluate and enhance the long-term durability of vehicle structures.
